subject: [PATCH v3 7/7] mm: use VMA flag helpers in NUMA balancing

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Identified an indentation issue in the patch and expressed satisfaction with the overall direction of the changes. However, did not thoroughly review the code for other potential issues.

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch series introduces VMA flag helpers to improve code readability and maintainability in the NUMA balancing code. The changes use vma_test() instead of directly accessing vm_flags, which simplifies the code and reduces potential errors.
